name: Knott's Calico Tater Bites Crispy Tater Tots with Melted Cheddar & Bacon (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Calico Tater Bites (Ghost Town · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Shredded white potato tots have no skins or seeds; ordering them plain or with melted cheddar & bacon (holding jalapeños, raw green onions, and spicy sauces) makes a fun shareable snack.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain Tater Bites or Cheddar & Bacon Tater Bites with NO jalapeños, NO raw onions, and NO chili.
watchOuts: Deep-fried tots + cheese sauce—share a basket and take lactase
